title.en: Info-communications Media Development Authority (Interest on Late Payment of Financial Penalties) Regulations 2026

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Info-communications Media Development Authority (Interest on Late Payment of Financial Penalties) Regulations 2026 and come into operation on 2 October 2026.

heading.en: Interest on late payment of financial penalties

text.en:
3.—(1) For the purpose of section 79A(1) of the Act, the prescribed rate of interest on any unpaid amount of any financial penalty mentioned in that provision (called in this regulation the outstanding sum) is 4.5 percentage points above the 3‑month compounded SORA.
(2) The interest mentioned in paragraph (1) is payable starting on the date after the outstanding sum is due up to and including the date the outstanding sum is paid.
